Wrote the architecture draft for TetrisGame at `artifacts/process-runs/d5834274-5f17-4671-9c7b-007a1a7fe244/steps/draft-architecture-design.md`.

Key decisions:
- Blazor WebAssembly PWA using the grounded `blazorwasm --pwa` contract
- Client-only, static-hosting-compatible app with no backend/API dependency
- UI, application, domain, and infrastructure boundaries separated
- Browser-local score persistence behind `ILocalScoreStore`
- xUnit test seams for pure rules and orchestration
